farmer_query_en: What should I do at harvest stage of cotton in south india?
content: COTTON in south india should follow stage-wise agronomic operations. Sowing window: May-June. Seed rate: 2.5-3 kg/ha (Bt); 3-4 kg/ha (desi). Spacing: 90 cm x 60 cm (Bt); 60 cm x 30 cm (desi). Fertilizer: NPK 150:75:75 kg/ha; basal 1/3 N + full P + full K; top-dress at squaring and boll development.. contentHi: दक्षिण भारत में कपास के लिए कटाई अवस्था पर सभी काम समय से करें। बुवाई अवधि May-June रखें, बीज दर 2.5-3 kg/ha (Bt); 3-4 kg/ha (desi) और दूरी 90 cm x 60 cm (Bt); 60 cm x 30 cm (desi) अपनाएं। उर्वरक प्रबंधन: NPK 150:75:75 kg/ha; basal 1/3 N + full P + full K; top-dress at squaring and boll development.। सिंचाई प्रबंधन: 8-10 irrigations; critical at squaring, flowering and boll development.।
